author: aniriat2025

title: The tour was awesome, but the organization was a little chaotic.
text:
We originally booked the afternoon tour, but later received an email asking if we could switch to the night tour. Overall, the organization felt a bit chaotic. However, we were still able to see the Alhambra, so we were happy in the end.

Christian was our tour guide and he was excellent. His storytelling was engaging, he was able to answer all of our questions, and he had great timing throughout the tour. He was also very friendly and even took great photos of us.
